prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one exceptionally polished, high-resolution landscape visual proposal for the redesigned BTC.EDU learning platform. This is a finished UI design presentation image, before development. Show three front-facing flat UI panels arranged as a balanced design board: a large student desktop view, a large educator desktop view, and a narrow mobile student view. Render at generous resolution, ideally a 3840 × 2160 landscape canvas, with sharp readable Spanish text, precise layout and no perspective tilt. Panels must be large enough to inspect. Small exterior captions: "Estudiante", "Educador", "Móvil". No hardware desk scene, no browser chrome, no giant ornamental headline outside the panels.

Preserve BTC.EDU identity: exact wordmark "BTC.EDU" in a black dot-matrix lettering style; warm ivory paper and white surfaces, near-black ink, restrained warm orange accents, thin dark borders, subtle industrial grid, small squared corners. Typography faithful to the established NType82/NType82 Headline character, clean highly legible headings and body; Space Mono-like small supporting labels. Solid black primary buttons with white text. Industrial brushed-metal and translucent orange geometric illustrations only as small course thumbnails. Beautiful generous spacing, disciplined hierarchy, no purple/blue dashboard aesthetic, no gradients, no pill-heavy cards, no oversized illustration that competes with tasks.

Student desktop: header contains BTC.EDU wordmark, compact appearance icon, notification bell with small badge and account avatar. Stable left sidebar in this exact order: "Explorar", "Mi aprendizaje" (active with a slim orange marker), "Compras", "Comunidad". Main title "Mi aprendizaje". First and most dominant content is a horizontal continuation card: small industrial thumbnail, "Continúa aprendiendo", "Bitcoin desde cero", "Siguiente lección: BTC y satoshis", "1 de 4 lecciones", progress bar 25%, black primary button "Continuar lección". Below, restrained secondary tabs "Cursos", "Recursos", "Guardados", "Certificados"; a search field "Buscar en mis cursos"; two concise course cards "Lightning desde cero" and "Wallets y autocustodia" with simple progress/status and "Ver curso". Avoid decorative analytics above continuation. Show a small textual link "Explorar cursos". Student dashboard is about learning, not promoting payment.

Educator desktop: same brand, colors, typography and header utilities. Stable sidebar in this exact order: "Mi estudio" (active), "Contenido", "Alumnos", "Comunidad", "Ventas". Main title "Mi estudio", black primary button "Crear contenido". Show two compact actionable pending cards "Preguntas pendientes" with "Responder" and "Observaciones de revisión" with "Corregir". A content list headed "Tu contenido" includes the course "Bitcoin desde cero", clearly separated text "Publicación actual: Versión 1" and "Cambios en preparación: Borrador", with "Continuar borrador". Another concise row "Facturas Lightning", state "En revisión", action "Ver revisión". A short subordinate publication checklist with "Información", "Contenido", "Vista del estudiante" and a black button "Enviar a revisión". Publication belongs to editorial review; never show a creator button "Publicar ahora". No payout balance, income claim, fake sales chart or nominal student roster.

Mobile: reproduce the student's "Mi aprendizaje" vocabulary and visual hierarchy at a practical phone screen width, simple top header BTC.EDU, notification bell and "Menú"; continuation card with "Bitcoin desde cero", "BTC y satoshis", progress 25% and a large black "Continuar" button visible near the top. Compact "Tus cursos" cards below. Preserve the same navigation destinations through the clearly labeled menu, do not cram a desktop sidebar into mobile or rename Mi aprendizaje to Mi espacio.

All visible content is illustrative. Outside the product panels add only a discreet caption "Propuesta visual · BTC.EDU". No in-product development, regtest, test-wallet, technical status or demo banners. No invented accreditation, recommendations, reviews, statistics, currency conversions or "Pago único". Exact Spanish accents and clear contrast. Clean, realistic, usable web application design, not a futuristic dashboard.

Edit this BTC.EDU UI proposal image with exactly one targeted correction. Keep the entire composition, three panels, identity, colors, typography, all other text, layout, illustrations and controls unchanged.
Change only the bottom card in the Educador panel, currently titled "Lista de verificación de publicación". Make it an explicitly scoped next-task card for the draft of the course shown above.
Replace that card title with "Siguiente paso: Bitcoin desde cero".
Replace the empty three-step checklist with one short, readable explanation: "Revisa la vista del estudiante y los requisitos antes de enviar."
Change the black button label from "Enviar a revisión" to "Revisar borrador", preserving its dimensions and placement.
This educator home card guides the user back to the correct draft; it must not imply sending an unspecified content or that unchecked requirements are already met.
Do not change any other part of the image. Keep sharp readable Spanish text and preserve the original image resolution and opaque background.
